name: thick_pod_closure_clearance
hypothesis: The enlarged tablet measures 40 by 30 by 16.25 mm: its aligned footprint fits the groove, but it protrudes 4.25 mm above the groove face. It tests whether closure contact can dislodge a pod after its placement check has passed.
expected_failure: If the extra protrusion exhausts closure clearance, step 8 either fails to close or displaces the pod. Displacement followed by successful closure could produce claimed success with pod_in_groove false.
real_world_story: The household switches to a larger detergent tablet that still fits the dispenser opening.
